chunks: And thus have We placed in every city the greatest of the sinners to contrive and deceive; yet they contrive against no one but themselves even though they do not know.

key_terms.أَكَابِرَ: The greatest or most prominent ones

ai.seo_question: Who are the akabir (greatest ones) mentioned in the Quran as being placed in every city?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom of utilizing the 'elites of criminals' as instruments of trial, where their internal corruption leads to their own downfall. It underscores the concept of 'natural consequence' (tabi'at al-ashya'), where the schemers' plots rebound upon them due to their own lack of true awareness, serving as a lesson for the community.
